script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -u
rm -rf /tmp/xm-cx-pages && mkdir -p /tmp/xm-cx-pages
echo '' | base64 -d > /tmp/xm-cx-pages/p.tgz
tar -xzf /tmp/xm-cx-pages/p.tgz -C /tmp/xm-cx-pages
sudo cp -r /tmp/xm-cx-pages/tools /var/www/xinmo-site/
sudo cp /tmp/xm-cx-pages/assets/js/resources.js /var/www/xinmo-site/assets/js/resources.js 2>/dev/null || true
sudo chown -R www-data:www-data /var/www/xinmo-site/tools/chaoxing-speed 2>/dev/null || true
echo "== pages done =="
ls -l /var/www/xinmo-site/tools/chaoxing-speed/
